title: Organisation
caption: Recording and questions, in two rules.
recording: The theory part is recorded and published on YouTube.
questions: Questions: raise your hand in Zoom, and I pause the recording first.

talking-points.description: The theory part is recorded. Raise your hand in Zoom and I pause the recording before the question comes.

pause-first.description: Pause the recording before taking a question, so no participant's voice lands on YouTube.
